name: Trident Texofab Limited
about: Trident Texofab Limited engages in the manufacture and wholesale trading of textile fabric cloth in India. The company offers grey, embroidered, digital printed, polyester, and poly-blend fabrics; bed sheets; technical textiles; and suiting products. It also provides value-added services, such as embroidery, stitching, and digital printing. In addition, the company trades in home furnishing products comprising bed sheets, curtains, cushion covers, and upholstery; institutional textiles; and clothing articles, including scarves, pareos, suiting, shirting, and technical textile fabrics. Trident Texofab Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Surat, India.
